title: NSIC Rc 674 (Tubigan 58) Rice Variety: Characteristics and Grain Quality
metaTitle: NSIC Rc 674 Rice Variety: Characteristics and Grain Quality
metaDescription: NSIC Rc 674 (Tubigan 58) is an inbred rice for irrigated lowland, approved in 2022. See its pest and disease ratings, grain quality and where it grows best.
excerpt: NSIC Rc 674 is an inbred rice variety for irrigated lowland, known locally as Tubigan 58. The NSIC approved it in 2022. Its days to harvest and trial yield are not published yet, but its pest ratings and grain quality are below.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for rice variety 674, or Rc 674, this is the one. Compare it with the other varieties in our [rice variety finder](/rice-varieties) before you buy seed. blocks.text: How many days does it take, and how much does it yield?

This variety's days to harvest and trial yields are not published yet. So ask the seed seller or your municipal agriculturist for the figures from the trials in your region before you plan the season. Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with the [growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it. Meanwhile, our guide to [raising rice yield per hectare](/blog/increase-rice-yield-per-hectare) covers the habits that matter with any variety.

blocks.text: So scout early for [tungro](/diseases/rice-tungro). When you see the first signs, check the guide before you spray, because the right timing saves more than an extra dose. If you are not sure what you see, our [pest and disease finders](/features/pest-and-disease-finders) help you name it from the damage.

Amylose decides how rice cooks. With intermediate amylose, expect rice that is soft but not sticky. In fact, Filipino taste has moved from high to intermediate and low amylose rice, because people want it softer. Head rice is the share of whole grains after milling. So a higher number means fewer broken grains and a better price at the mill.

It suits irrigated lowland, where you control the water. Level the field well so the water stands evenly, and plant together with the farms around you, so pests cannot move from field to field. Our guide to [rice land preparation](/land-preparation/rice-land-preparation) shows each step. You can plant it wet direct seeded. For the right month in your province, see [the best time to plant rice](/blog/best-time-to-plant-rice-philippines).

items.q: What is the local name of NSIC Rc 674?
items.a: It is known as Tubigan 58. Seed sellers and agriculturists use both names, so ask for either one.
The NSIC approved it in 2022. Its days to harvest and trial yield are not published yet, so ask for the regional trial figures before you plant.
No, it is an inbred. So the seed you buy grows true, but certified seed still gives the best start.

items.q: What should I watch for when I plant it?
items.a: In trials it was weak against tungro. So scout from the early weeks and act at the first signs.
It has intermediate amylose, 18.5 percent. So it cooks soft but not sticky.

items.q: Where can I buy certified seed of this variety?
items.a: Ask accredited seed growers in your province or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag on the sack before you pay.
